S&P 500 Market Intelligence Dashboard

Historical daily prices 2 Jan 2014 - 29 Dec 2017 · AnalystLab Africa Week 6 · Historical performance only - not investment advice, not current market data

Dashboard embeds 60 stocks (the 10 selected + the 50 most-traded full-history stocks). Page 1 KPIs cover all 505 symbols. Returns exclude 13 flagged non-market events.

General market overview: 483 of 505 symbols have a full-period history; 22 are partial (listed or removed during the period, e.g. APTV 18 days). Prices are as supplied (currency not stated, USD assumed; adjustment for splits/dividends cannot be verified).

Volume = number of shares traded (not money value). Zero-volume placeholder rows are excluded.
